concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone finished animal mascot application icon concept, square 1024 by 1024.
Design an ORIGINAL beautifully art-directed little squirrel identity for a quiet personal knowledge companion: it gathers insights from videos watched and helps the owner retain and rediscover them. The user wants extreme simplicity, lively personality, and genuine graphic design.
Subject: a tiny alert squirrel in right-facing profile, its oversized elegantly curling tail makes a strong almost circular S-like silhouette, small forward-tilted rounded-point ear, one tiny dark eye, compact body, short front paws tenderly holding exactly one small golden-orange seed close to its chest. The silhouette has an inquisitive upward tilt, subtly asymmetrical organic curves, calm clever personality. Aim for a memorable custom symbol composed of 4-6 confident shapes with wonderfully balanced negative space. Tail is the primary graphic gesture, animal clearly reads as squirrel, NOT snail or fox. Seed means keeping one valuable insight. The motif should be immediately legible when small. Give the squirrel a distinctive tall curled tail and a tiny substantial head and thoughtful posture.
Style: polished independent macOS productivity app brand, beautiful economical flat vector-like spot illustration with a little organic drawing personality; sophisticated, warm, gently playful, not childish. Crisp smooth contours, no thick outlines.
Color: warm persimmon/rust orange squirrel with one pale cream cheek/chest cutout and a tiny deep-brown eye. Pale warm ivory rounded-square app tile, monochromatic flat fill. Large generous 18 percent breathing space around the animal. Tile nearly fills image with consistent small transparent border, rounded corners. Transparent beyond tile.
Composition: one centered animal on one single rounded-square app tile, front-on flat view. Not a presentation sheet; not several icons.
No typography, no letters, no words, no numerals, no book, no spectacles, no graduation hat, no overt play button, no brain, no lightbulb, no sparkles, no extra animals, no 3D, no fur texture, no photorealism, no gradients, no bevels, no shadows, no stock clipart.

comparison_board.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a NEW professional art-directed animal application icon comparison board, opaque landscape canvas, approximately 1800 by 1100 pixels.
The three supplied images are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY for three mascots. Create a completely new clean presentation; do not reproduce their rough transparency, cream app tiles, shadows, gradients or backgrounds.
Make three evenly spaced columns on one uninterrupted completely opaque warm ivory background. A restrained editorial brand designer's contact sheet, beautiful generous negative space.
Column 01: the squirrel from reference 1, warm persimmon orange with a warm ivory cheek and one little amber seed; keep the magnificent curled S-tail and curious raised head, refine shapes for slightly more economy and personality.
Column 02: the floating otter from reference 2, dark chocolate brown with ivory chest and an amber pebble; retain the diagonal float, relaxed eyes, little arms and curling tail, simplify whiskers/mouth, make fewer confident shapes.
Column 03: the flying swallow from reference 3, deep ink teal with ivory throat and single amber seed by the beak; retain the raised crescent wing and iconic forked tail, soften eye and throat design.
Each is an independently recognizable ORIGINAL mascot. Not stock clipart or merely standard emoji. Same optical size and visual weight, similar 250-300 pixel visible width, each centered in the upper middle of its own column with wide margins, no app tile behind animals. The art must be genuinely flat with very clean solid color fills, smooth deliberate contours and no textures, no gradient, absolutely no shading or drop shadows.
Below each large colored mascot, with plenty of space, show ONE smaller approximately 68-pixel matching SINGLE-COLOR DARK-INK icon of that same animal. These are SIMPLIFIED MENU BAR adaptations, not miniature detailed copies: preserve signature silhouette (curling squirrel tail / bean-shaped otter with short tail / crescent swallow with forked tail) but remove tiny internal detail; ivory/transparent negative space only when needed for recognition. Exact silhouette family relationship to the larger colored animal above must be obvious. The board contains exactly 3 large colored mascots and exactly 3 small dark monochrome adaptations.
Under each small icon, a crisp understated sans-serif label exactly "01  松鼠", "02  水獭", "03  燕子" respectively, dark muted ink. Accurate Chinese text. Align all labels along a common horizontal baseline.
No main title, no explanatory text, no extra shapes, no dividers, no color swatches, no decorative bubbles, no water, no beige app tile. No transparency anywhere in the final board. Opaque warm ivory background throughout, including all four corners. This is a refined comparison for choosing a mascot for a knowledge collection desktop app.
